title: Lesson 8. Many questions
subtitle: Размеры, материалы и вопросы о товаре

sections.title: 1. Sizes and materials
sections.text: Clothes sizes from the smallest to the largest: {XS}, {S}, {M}, {L}, {XL}, {XXL}. Materials: {plastic}, {glass}, {metal}, {wood}, {rubber} and {cotton}. Windows are made of {glass}; tyres are made of {rubber}; a T-shirt can be made of {cotton}; the skateboard in the conversation is made of {wood}. If you don't know what {size} you need, you can ask a shop-assistant or {try} the clothes {on}.
chain: XS S M L XL XXL

sections.title: 2. Questions about a product
sections.text: Where {is it made}? What {is it made of}? How {long} is it? Is it long {enough} for him? What {size} are these shoes? Where {are they made}? How {much} are they? Can I {try them on}? Questions with Wh-words have {falling} intonation.

sections.title: 3. In the shop
sections.text: Customer: What size are these shoes? Assistant: They are {8 and a half}. Customer: I'm afraid they are {too big}. Can I try them {on}? Later: Oh, they are just the {right size}! Where are they made? — They are made in {Korea}. How much are they? — They used to be {49,99}, but they are on {sale}: it's {50%} off, which makes less than {25 pounds}. Customer: I think I'll {take} them.

flashcards.q: Расставьте от меньшего к большему: M, XL, S, XS, L, XXL.
flashcards.a: XS, S, M, L, XL, XXL.

flashcards.q: Как спросить, из чего сделан товар?

flashcards.a: How much is it? / How much are they?
